source_clause: C7.) Defrost has on/ off state. Defrost can automatically turn on AC (do not show this change). Defrost automatically changes Fan speed. Defrost is mutually exclusive with other airflow modes. Auto turns Defrost off. Turning Defrost on while in Auto will break Auto and turn it off. When Defrost is active, Recirc is may or may not be available (reflect in recirc availability status). Therefore, gray out the RECIRC button when recirc availability status from CCM denotes that.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.8（C7）以七句定出 Defrost 之狀態、其對 A/C 與風速之自動作用、與其他氣流模式之互斥、與 AUTO 之互相關閉，以及 Recirc 可用性之灰化，六個 037 leaf 逐句對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：本節無配置條件，起始 PC 為 test-setup；`012-05`（AUTO 與 Defrost 互相關閉）另取第一軸之 ATC 值（C2「AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations」，出處 2.3，併入 spec_ref 依 R-C29）；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，EMEA 排除補並逐條答，第十二軸不補。為什麼這樣切：`012-05` 之兩個方向（AUTO 關掉 Defrost、Defrost 中斷 AUTO）為 037 之同一 leaf，故合為一條而以兩組步驟涵蓋（§8.2 單位歸 037）；`012-06` 之灰化以 CCM 之可用性狀態為觸發，與 `012-02` 之 on/off 無關。刻意略過：**不移植 `3.2`（C20）之 MAX DEF 連動** —— 本節之 Defrost 為 C7 之 `FRONT DEF`，與 MAX DEF 為不同控制、不同條文（§8.2.1）；C7 之「Recirc **is may or may not be** available」為條文之語病，本條依其可判之部分（灰化）立 ER，不推斷其可用性規則。

tcs.tc_title: Defrost has an on and off state
tcs.test_item:
C7.) Defrost has on/ off state.

(The climate screen is open and the climate system is on; press "FRONT DEF" again)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "FRONT DEF" on the climate screen
2. Press "FRONT DEF" again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "FRONT DEF" button is highlighted
2. The "FRONT DEF" button is no longer highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Turning AUTO on turns Defrost off
tcs.test_item:
Turning Defrost on while in Auto will break Auto and turn it off.

(The vehicle has an ATC climate system; turn AUTO on and read the "FRONT DEF" button)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has an ATC climate system, in which AUTO is shown (2.3)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn "FRONT DEF" on from the climate screen
2. Turn AUTO on and read the "FRONT DEF" button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "FRONT DEF" button is highlighted
2. The "FRONT DEF" button is no longer highlighted
tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「Auto turns Defrost off. Turning Defrost on while in Auto will break Auto and turn it off」—— 故一觸發一條。兩個方向各自可失效：AUTO 關得掉 Defrost 而 Defrost 關不掉 AUTO，是一種失效。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）

tcs.test_item_authored: Auto shall turn Defrost off, and turning Defrost on while in Auto shall break Auto and turn it off
